question: Has a production regression from the merged dispatch-422 repair been demonstrated strongly enough that restoring its known failure modes is the safer incident response?
rationale: The branch intentionally reintroduces known availability and payload-compatibility failures, so code review cannot decide whether an unobserved operational regression justifies that tradeoff.

options.title: Keep the draft as contingency
options.body: Leave the rollback unmerged until redacted production evidence identifies a current-main regression and a safer forward fix is ruled out.

options.title: Approve incident rollback
options.body: Merge only after Martin explicitly accepts the restored dispatch risks for a demonstrated production incident.

options.title: Replace with a forward repair
options.body: Create a narrow fix that addresses the observed regression while retaining scoped 422 handling and nested source-head compatibility.

recommendation.title: Keep the draft as contingency
recommendation.body: Leave the rollback unmerged until redacted production evidence identifies a current-main regression and a safer forward fix is ruled out.
